correctness.rationale: The 32767 nonzero quartics are partitioned by the full 168-element rational projective group. Unit Gröbner ideals of (f,fu,fv) on all three affine charts certify smoothness over an algebraic closure. The first exact program finds 279 total orbits, 78 smooth orbits totaling 10920 forms, then 20 tangent-filling smooth orbits totaling 2656; a differently encoded and generator-based program independently recovers 2782 rational-incidence candidates, 126 geometrically singular ones, 20 smooth orbits and the same seven-row joint distribution. The three-point example has a direct derivative proof. No infinite-field assertion is inferred from the finite census.

value.rationale: The tangent-line union condition is the natural dual blocking-set invariant of the rational Gauss map introduced in a primary 2023 finite-field geometry paper. Smooth plane quartics over F2 form the canonical nonhyperelliptic genus-three family in the smallest characteristic-two field. The complete classification, sharp minimum three rational points in four classes, and 616 nonblocking-but-tangent-filling equations quantify a structural distinction not given by the 78-class moduli classification alone. A complete finite classification of a natural incidence locus is valuable without a general-field theorem.
